reviews.comment: Say your prayers. She laughs at you when you ask questions, and gets mad at low class averages. I have never in my life been more lost in a class than I am right now, and it is NOT from a lack of effort.

Very rushed lecturer and gets frustrated when students don't quickly grasp concepts that have barely been covered. She does not do example problems in class and the grade is solely based on quizzes and exams, and quizzes are very difficult with only one attempt, and she doesn't respond to emails in a timely manner.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Reads straight off slides
good luck lol

pick anyone else!! exams are NOTHING like the practice problems she gives. Hardest class I have taken and the professor is NOT helpful. When lecturing she makes it seem easy, but the test are EXTREMELY different and out of the ball park compared to her lecture. save yourself :)
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: By far one of the hardest classes I've ever taken. Dr. Perez was a great teacher that explained things well, but going to office hours to get a more clear understanding is very necessary. Tests were very hard but doable if you study well and really understand the material. Gives tons of EC and curves heavy.

Hard class in general, as many of the material on her exams can be very niche or requires you to know everything of extra details she said in class. It is recommended to go to her office hours to try to understand what possible connections can be made during lecture or you may need to study really excessively. Extra credit(s) was extremely helpful.

Lectures are recorded. It can be difficult to reach her outside of class, as email responses are often delayed or inconsistent. Grades take a long time to be posted. Lecture depth does not always match exam content (e.g. heavy focus on hemoglobin with little exam coverage). Some extra credit and a curve are offered, but they are limited in help.

Hard hard hard class with really hard exams.  I really like Perez though cause she is really nice and accessible outside of class.  She is funny and you can tell that she actually cares.  Its a hard class, but she curved all the exams and offered extra credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The exams are challenging but include easier questions too. She curves 11–15 pts each exam (including the final) and gives 15 pts extra credit, so there's help. I studied a week before each exam and earned low As/high Bs pre-curve. You must study the slides, but an A is very doable. I was worried at first but will take her again for BICH 411.

Very unhelpful professor. Exams are unreasonably difficult and specific (many questions ask about a term shown once in small-print on one slide [not discussed in class]). You need to memorize examples, not concepts. No HW. Practice exams provided but much easier than actual exams. Lectures are rushed and disorganized, self-teaching is a necessity.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class has been the hardest course I have taken at TAMU. Perez doesn't make it any easier. She belittles students too. Exams are very hard she does do second attempts and extra credit. Class average was mid-low C throughout the whole semester. Overall would not take her if given the opportunity.

One of the worst I've ever taken. Take anyone else but her. Lectures are all over the place, no time for students outside of class, & the class average was failing. It irks me that the Biochem department allows professors like this, because this is the 3rd I've ran into that refuses to teach & only reads back slides to you like it's kindergarten
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Take anyone else but Perez. Pretty much unreachable outside of class, will not respond to emails, and only 1 hour a week for office hours. TA and SI sessions were not helpful. Quizzes do not ready you for the exams at all. Did not teach any application, like how to apply a peptide to serine protease mechanism, just sprung it on us during the exam.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very content heavy, extremely hard exams but provide opportunities for extra credit and second chance questions. Make sure to study before and after lectures to make sure you are not behind. She is nice but can make lecture a bit confusing sometimes.

Simply put: take someone else. Never responds to emails. Class is only out of 700 points. Puts in grades extremely late. Only reads off of her unorganized slides. Take someone else. Just hoping she curves the final grade.

This class is rough and I do not recc taking it online (I had no choice). No homework. Only weekly quizzes and exams. 3 midterm 1 final cumulative. Lectures recorded & posted but slides are a completed wreck. There are a million of them and they need to be condensed. Some are repeating and it was just annoying. Will curve exams. Take someone else.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Caring professor and overall personable, no complaints. Notes: do not neglect the class, studying is very time consuming if you want to do well, make sure your schedule isn't saturated with other heavy classes (the mistake I made), NO HW so use outside sources to practice, extra credit given, second attempts for exams, few grades, join groupme.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR! Quizzes are easy, but exams are out of left field. TA sessions and SI are not helpful. She gives you a second attempt on exams, but when you take them it doesn't require lock down browser…apparently she does this add the points if it's taken regularly. No where does it mention this by the way. DOES NOT RESPOND TO EMAILS!

I had Perez for both 410 & 411. By FAR the hardest classes I've taken. A study group was necessary for me because I didn't find her lectures, reviews, or SI to be helpful. Her exam questions are much harder than the quizzes. Meet with your study group regularly and teach each other concepts from her lecture slides. The textbook can also help.

Try to avoid this course if you can. Your grade on some assignments is also heavily influenced by the TA that you have. She is also not great with helping during office hours or over email, and overall seems very non-compassionate. Literally didn't show up one day when we had writing workshop and said nothing about it. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!
Extremely hard class and exams, study hard for them and don't get behind. She's fair with the exam questions and curves a good bit. Still this class is super hard and you have to work for the A.

Listen, Biochem is a hard subject. There is a lot of information going on at once and it can be overwhelming. But Dr. Perez does a good job breaking it down and connecting everything. Her lectures can be a little fast-paced and dense, so pay attention. She is funny, and keeps lectures engaging, though at times her dry humor can come off as rude.

She's one of the easier professors in the Biochemistry department, and truly wants her students to do well. Her exams are pretty difficult, as are all Biochem exams, but she provides a lot of extra credit. Make sure to study at least a week in advance for all of her exams if you want a chance at getting a good grade.
One of the hardest courses I've ever taken. There is a lot of outside studying that needs to be done and do not go in confident on the first exam, especially if you didn't put in the work.

Labs are easy but taking good notes during them is what helped me a lot! Optional extra credit presentation. Have to read 3 papers & really understand them, not just skim. Had consistent office hours where she's willing to go over all topics with you again and make sure you know what's going on. If you put in the work, you will pass.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Just thinking of her gives me PTSD...
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Lots of outside studying was needed to do good in this course ( I went to almost every SI). I liked Dr. Perez as a person but she was not the most effective teacher. She was really helpful in office hours and offered lots of extra credit on her tests. She somehow lectures fast and slow at the same time so find a friend in case you miss something.

This is the absolute least considerate professor I have ever met. She brags about how many people she has caught plagiarizing in her class. I asked for an extension for a test due to illness and she stated, "It wouldn't be fair to the class" even though I had a doctor's note. She assigns WAY too much work for a 2 credit class. AVOID IF YOU CAN.

Dr. Perez gives extra credit and doesn't like to see her class fail. There's a LOT of material to memorize, so you still have to put a ton of time into this class. The exams are hard, and all the multiple-choice questions are difficult, but she tells you the write-outs ahead of time so you can memorize them. Attend SI and you'll be fine
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Definitely the hardest class I took at A&M. Make sure to go class, study lots, and be prepared to work hard! I think Dr. Perez is nice and offers extra credit opportunities, but her exams are very difficult. I am very bad at multiple choice tests so I struggled a lot, but the free response portion of exams are very easy as long as you go to class.

LOVE HER! The class is hard. The only way to do good is by reading and truly UNDERSTANDING the concepts in the slides, no memorization aside from mechanisms. She cracks jokes while speeding through the slides. A lot nicer than Pozzi. Know EXACT inhibitors/activators for EVERY enzyme mentioned and ur gold for the multiple choice q's for exams 1&2
If you want to graduate, DON'T take this professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Perez was ok. She had quizzes that were pretty easy but her exams were insanely hard. We had to have huge curves and second attempts cause the class average was always failing. Her lectures are pointless she just directly reads off a PowerPoint. To do well know every single slide that she provides and read the student notes, then pray for luck

Biochem is a hard subject to begin. She lectures fast and uses PowerPoint only. 3 extra credit opportunities were given along with 1 make up exam questions. Weekly quizzes were open notes and her exams are conceptual based, no memorization. I went to office hours everyday so she was familiar with me but unfortunately i will be graduating late.
Just don't if you want to be happy.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Labs work decent but the hard part is applying to research paper. Writing papers consist majority of grade and she provides no clear rubric. Provides no feedback in emails or in office hours. Feedback is given long past due date and expects 30 page papers. If your looking for decent writing intensive course this is not it.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: The worst professor in the history of the planet. AVOID HER at all costs. I didnt graduate on time because of her. No heart and no compassion whatsoever. She doesnt care at all.

Gave second attempts & extra credit bc class was doing so bad. She lectures very fast so read ppts & student notes beforehand. Exams + quizzes + HWs were extremely difficult so make sure to know the slides + amino acids inside out and you will prob do well. Start studying amino acids from day 1! She doesn't respond to emails so talk to her irl

Love her and her personality, but feel like her teaching could have been more thorough. Lots of questions on exams that feel very extrapolated but not enough info covered on how to answer them. Some questions couldn't even be answered from textbook. Offered second chance quizzes after exams based on most missed questions as well as slight curving.

I was very nervous about taking biochem with Dr. Perez, but she is actually a great professor. She gives extra credit opportunities and really cares about her students. She is very funny and makes lectures enjoyable. The only bad thing I have to say is she lectures really fast, so take quick notes, but other than that she is great!!

Dr. Perez was FANTASTIC! Biochem 411 is hard work and takes a lot of studying but after failing Organic Chemistry I was very nervous taking this class. She explains everything very well and has fair exams. Definitely take her as this will be a hard class with whoever you take.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Perez filled in for Pozzi for us this semester. She was great, though she did tend to read directly off of the slides a little too much. But she really cared, and I felt that she communicated the material well. I didn't use anything other than her slides/lectures to study and ended with a high A. She's pretty funny too

Dr.Perez is a great professor her lectures might not be the most engaging, but she wants to make sure you are really learning the material. This is a difficult class no matter who you take it with but Dr.Perez is a great choic.

I did very well on every exam and ended this class with over a 100. All the folks giving Dr. Perez 1/5 are failing to consider that this class is very difficult no matter the prof. You will need to memorize almost every thing on every slide in order to get A's on exams. I used Anki to memorize everything and it worked VERY well for me.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I really struggled in this class, I don't think she's a terrible professor but she is very inaccessible outside of class and is quite sarcastic when trying to communicate with her
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: this class made me hate science, exams difficulty is not at all equal to how well she teaches- our exam averages were constantly 10-15 points lower than any other professors. take anyone else

worst professor hands down.. usually if a prof has a subpar personality they make up for it by being a great lecturer and if they arent a great lecturer they make up for that with a good personality ... dr Perez has none of those
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: D class average on every exam. Exam review material is always misleading.

By far the best chemistry professor at A&M. What makes her so wonderful is that she is extremely accommodating to the needs of the class. When exams scores are low she provides a way to earn points back. The most important thing about this class is doing the work and practicing!!  She gives you everything you need to do well in class.

If you have a chance to take her, DO IT. The ratings on here are so bad but ignore them!! She single handedly helped out my grade so much and provided SOOOO many bonus points. She seems intimating at first, but she is a SWEETHEART!! Dont let her fool you. She is a GEM!!!

I took Dr. Perez this Fall 2021 semester and she cares so much about her students and she's hilarious in lecture. If you get confused she is more than happy to help during her office hours and really helps you understand the material. This is honestly the best class I have taken at TAMU in my four years here.

This class is hard. Theres no getting around that. However, I cant explain enough how much stress Perez took out of this course. She is extremely generous with curves/extra points. She wants her students to do well and will be very upfront with you about material you need to know. Also, incredibly accessible through group me. Highly recommend!

this is a hard class, Perez explains well. But on the exams most of the material is meant to be tackled using critical thinking which makes exams hard. EC built into each exam but you need get 100% for it. Perez is Always accessible through group me so thats a plus. She's also upfront. To get an A go to class and review material each day. take her!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Perez for both BICH 410 and 411. Her test are hard but she is extremely generous with the curve. She always responds very promptly on GroupMe and holds reviews for exams on Fridays when needed. She is a really good professor and very passionate about her career. Also, she prepares students very well for graduate school! Take her

Dr. Perez understands the material herself, there is no denying that. However, she is an abysmal lecturer who mainly reads over the slides. Do not expect her test questions to be anything like her easy quizzes. Her exams are by far the hardest I have taken in college and I breezed through Ochem. Expect to memorize pages of mechanisms and pathways.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took BICH 410 online with Dr. Perez during the Spring 2021 semester. Her online exams are open note and un-proctered. As a result, they are extremely difficult. Organize your notes! She gives summary PDFs, but I recommend watching her video lectures, since she pulls many questions from them. She is accessible through GroupMe and is very chill.

Biochem is hard but she held reviews that helped a lot (she makes things seem way simpler in-person). She extended the dates for our HW and exams multiple times (spring 21- nuf said)! She even curved the exams w/ really low averages (by like 5-10 points). The only problem i have is the HW doesn't go along w/ the exams/quizzes and is waay harder
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class was completely online, and the lectures were posted as recordings. That will probably change after covid. The material wasn't too difficult, but it definitely takes some studying. There are 3 big homework assignments, and they are weighted heavily. 8 quizzes, lowest 3 are dropped. Not the easiest prof, but she will make sure you learn.

Take this class only if you think you're super smart, even the smart ones don't survive. Her quizzes and test are so different from what she teaches in class. Her class may make you loose confidence in your ability as a student. run away now, DO NOT take her class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dont take her class. worst professor I've ever had. she decided to make class asynchronous, but lecture videos uploaded exceed designated lecture time by at least 1 hour a week, not including recitation. quiz almost every week. HW irrelevant and unrelated to material, just extra work. seems annoyed by questions asked. unclear and confusing.

Had her for Spring 2020 semester and she's by far the worst prof I've ever taken. Homework never correlated to the exams, was extremely hard, and 25% of your grade. Made us retake an exam due to her own mistake. Horrible at replying to emails, extremely unhelpful, and will not own up to her own mistakes. Do not take her, anyone else will do better.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've had. Period. She doesn't curve whatsoever and does not respond to emails in a timely manner, if at all. She also makes the class way harder than it needs to be with homework questions that don't correlate to what's on the test and lectures that are long and confusing. Do not take this professor, as anyone else will be better.

Worst proff. I've ever had HANDS DOWN. Doesn't care about her students at all (even in the midst of a pandemic). Made the whole class retake a test that she messed up. Homework is extremely confusing and is worth 25% our you grade. NEVER responds to emails. She's extremely arrogant and blames everyone but herself. Doesn't curve. Don't take!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I had Perez during the Covid19 semester and the only thing you need to know about her is that she didnt care what we were going through. Her recorded lectures were much longer than the normal class time, she barely responded to emails, and she made us all retake an exam because of a mistake she made. Science classes usually curve, but she didnt.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I was afraid to take this course due to the rigor of Biochem 1 and this class is not an easy class, but Dr. Perez is highly intelligent and I loved her class! If you read the book, you should be fine! I studied for 30 hours one weekend to make sure I did well in this class! The exams are tough but she wants to make sure you know how to apply!

She made biochem so much harder than it needed to be. She put stuff on the exams that we had never, ever seen before and made them so much more difficult than other professors'. She did give a huge curve at the end of the semester, only because half of us were at a D or lower. Expect to make a C if you're doing above average in the class.

Dr. Perez is sweet. This was her first time teaching 411 and so it was rough on both ends. She made up for it by giving lots of extra credit. Tests were tough. 30% was writing out pathways and the other 70 was pretty specific mc. She also was willing to replace your lowest grade with the final.
